import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    
    if k == 0:
        res = 1
        for _ in range(1, p):
            res = (res * p) % MOD
        print(res)
        return
    
    # find modular inverse of k modulo p by brute force
    inv = 1
    while (inv * k) % p != 1:
        inv += 1
    
    res = 1
    if k == 1:
        res = p
    
    flag = [False] * p  # indices 0..p-1
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not flag[i]:
            res = (res * p) % MOD
            j = i
            while not flag[j]:
                flag[j] = True
                j = (j * inv) % p
    
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
